With its Clean CARFAX and one-owner history, you can drive away with total peace of mind knowing this vehicle has been exceptionally well-cared for.Luxury You Can FeelStep inside and experience true comfort with Perforated Premium Milano Leather Trimmed Seats. Whether you're the driver or a passenger, you'll enjoy a personalized climate thanks to the front dual-zone A/C and separate rear air conditioning. The heated front sport seats and power moonroof ensure every trip is relaxing, while the memory settings for the seats, steering wheel, and even the HVAC system remember exactly how you like things.Advanced Technology at Your FingertipsThe "Technology" in its name isn't just for show. This MDX features a built-in Navigation System with 3D View to guide you on every journey, along with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for seamless smartphone integration. To keep you safe, this SUV is packed with driver-assist features like Lane Keeping Assist, Auto High-beam Headlights, and a clear Rear Parking Camera. With 3rd-row split-bench seating and a Power Liftgate, loading up the kids and all their gear has never been easier or more stylish.The Superior ExperienceChoosing this Acura MDX means choosing a vehicle that refuses to compromise on quality or performance. Its striking white pearl finish and sleek lines make a statement wherever you go, while the interior provides the space and tech your modern lifestyle demands. We invite you to see why our transparent approach to car buying makes all the difference in finding your next dream SUV.Faster. Simpler. More Transparent. Superior Automotive Group has helped thousands of customers find the right car by leveraging one of Arkansas' largest selections of new and pre-owned vehicles at unparalleled prices. Yet, it's our extra-mile customer service and uncommonly candid and respectful staff that have won the trust and loyalty of Arkansas drivers for 30 years. Come visit one of our Superior dealerships today and let us exceed your expectations.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

2023 Jeep Grand Cherokee L Summit Reserve 4x4 finished in Diamond Black Crystal Pearl-Coat with a Tupelo/Black interior trimmed in Palermo leather seats. Powered by the 5.7L HEMI V8 MDS VVT engine paired with the 8-speed automatic 8HP75 transmission, this Grand Cherokee L Summit Reserve combines V8 performance with Jeeps Quadra-Trac II 4WD system, Selec-Terrain traction management, and Quadra-Lift air suspension for a refined balance of capability and ride comfort.

The Summit Reserve trim represents the most premium configuration of the three-row Grand Cherokee L lineup. The cabin features heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row seats, power driver and passenger seats with integrated back massagers, driver-seat memory, heated steering wheel, and a deluxe headliner. Second-row seating includes a manual tip/slide function for easy access to the third row, while the power-folding third row allows the cabin to transition easily between passenger and cargo space.

Technology centers around Uconnect 5 Nav with a 10.1-inch touchscreen display, integrating Apple CarPlay, Google Android Auto, connected travel and traffic services, and a 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot capability. A 19-speaker high-performance audio system powered by a 950-watt amplifier delivers immersive sound throughout the cabin, while the front passenger interactive display adds additional convenience for navigation and media control.

Advanced safety and driver-assistance systems include Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Active Lane-Management System, Full-Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus, Blind-Spot and Cross-Path Detection, Parallel and Perpendicular Park Assist with Stop, Side Distance Warning, Pedestrian and Cyclist Emergency Braking, Intersection Collision-Assist System, Drowsy Driver Detection, and a Surround View Camera System. The Advanced ProTech Group IV further enhances driver awareness with a head-up display, night vision with pedestrian and animal detection, rear-view auto-dimming digital display mirror, and an interior rear-facing camera.

Factory-installed options add $12,455 in equipment value and include Diamond Black Crystal Pearl-Coat exterior paint, the Summit Reserve equipment enhancements featuring Palermo leather interior surfaces and upgraded audio system, the Advanced ProTech Group IV, the High Altitude appearance package with gloss-black exterior accents and 21-inch black painted aluminum wheels, the available 7-passenger seating configuration with second-row bench seating, and the 5.7L HEMI V8 engine upgrade.

The split-folding rear seats and generous cargo space allow you to easily accommodate all your gear, whether you're embarking on a weekend getaway or tackling your next outdoor expedition. The fabric seat trim and driver's seat-mounted armrest provide comfort and support, ensuring you arrive at your destination refreshed and ready for whatever lies ahead.

With its impressive capabilities, thoughtful features, and rugged good looks, the 2014 Toyota FJ Cruiser Base is the perfect companion for those who seek to explore the great outdoors. Experience the thrill of the open road and the freedom to venture off the beaten path.
